The '''Sentient Greataxe''' is a type of [[Weapons|Weapon]].

It is the direct Upgrade of the [[Living Axe]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Sentient Weapons evolve from their craftable Living counterpart after having dealt 50,000 damage.

== ''Usage'' ==

The Sentient Greataxe is a Melee Weapon. Its Attack Reach is 3 Blocks horizontally, and 8 Blocks vertically, which is the default attack reach

Each time it is swung, it performs a sweeping attack (though only visually if airborne or the attack cooldown is still up) and applies the [[Corrosion|Corrosion II]] Effect.
